user.title: Battery Opt
user.description: Prices come from Home Assistant's own OMIE integration - set it up first (Settings > Devices & services > Add > OMIE). The marstek_modbus entities are optional until the battery arrives: leave all four empty for planning-only mode (plans and savings are computed, nothing actuates). Note: force_mode, set_charge_power and set_discharge_power ship disabled by default in the Marstek integration - enable them first.

error.omie_not_set_up: The OMIE integration is not set up. Add it first: Settings > Devices & services > Add integration > OMIE.
error.battery_entities_all_or_none: Provide all four battery entities, or none of them (planning-only mode until the battery arrives).

init.title: Battery Opt parameters
init.description: Entities and parameters can be changed here at any time; the integration reloads on save. Add the four Marstek entities when the battery arrives.
